content.comment_body: Hello everyone, Is it possible to connect a frequency inverter to a [product_name] controller? For example, could this be done with a frequency inverter from [company_name]? Thank you in advance.

Yes, this is possible. You can also use the [product_name] controller to manage the setpoint for the frequency inverter. You can control the frequency inverter's start/stop and set operational preferences using the contacts on the [product_name] controller. Alternatively, you may use an analog output module (such as [product_name] AM2 AQ) on the [product_name] controller to send a 0 (2)-10V or 0-(4)-20mA signal for frequency setpoint adjustment, and utilize a single digital output for start/stop or run commands. A combination of these methods can also be implemented.
This is very helpful information. Thank you.

analysis.insight_summary: Forum members are examining whether a [product_name] controller can interface with a frequency inverter from a different manufacturer.
